maps.label: Anger
maps.citation: Wager TD, Kang J, Johnson TD, Nichols TE, Satpute AB, Barrett LF (2015). A Bayesian model of category-specific emotional brain responses. PLoS Comput Biol 11(4):e1004066.
maps.method: Bayesian spatial point process (BSPP) coordinate-based meta-analysis
maps.value_meaning: posterior expected number of activation centres
maps.threshold_label: display threshold chosen by the authors — not a significance test
maps.caveat: Shows where studies of anger tended to report activation peaks, as estimated by a statistical model; no single coloured region is specific to anger, because what differs between emotions is the overall pattern. The map has no negative values, so it cannot show decreases, and the 0.001 cut is a display choice, not a significance test.
